name: Sea Friends
description: A Village Friends add-on that gives the sea two peoples to befriend: the merfolk, Village Friends villagers from the waist up with fish tails, in coral Reef Towns; and the Prismari, the one-eyed, spined folk who built the ocean monuments, in deep Prism Courts. Their own jobs, trades, dialogue, leafy seadragons and glowjellies, and the Monument Seal that the guardians still obey.
